Kiro cloud sessions in 5 steps: close your laptop, Kiro keeps working

Five steps to let Kiro keep working after you close your laptop.

1. Start a session - Start a cloud session for a task.
2. Give it a goal - Describe the outcome you want.
3. Close your laptop - Cloud sessions persist when you disconnect.
4. Come back - Return to progress, not a blank screen.
5. Know the limits - Paid plans only. Up to ten at once.

Docs: https://kiro.dev/docs/cloud-sessions/
